plan.title: Closed RFQ Surrogate Bid After Expiry

steps.note: Open the existing closed RFQ directly on its Participants tab.
Enable the company setting required for surrogate bids after expiry.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Add the buyer-entered bid for Vendor A after the RFQ has closed.
Verify the RFQ response is present for Vendor A and marked as a surrogate bid.
Navigate to the comparison grid to verify the submitted bid value.
Confirm Vendor A's surrogate bid rate is 95.
